# Carpe Diem Tours

> > Award-winning guided tours and cultural experiences across Rome, Barcelona, Madrid, and other European destinations, specializing in skip-the-line ancient history tours, food experiences, and local insider activities.

Carpe Diem Tours offers semi-private and private guided tours focusing on iconic landmarks like the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill, alongside unique experiences like wine painting classes and authentic food tours. The site features comprehensive travel guides, historical insights, and practical tips for visiting Italy, Spain, and other European cities.

## Rome Tours & Experiences

- [Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Tour](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/colosseum-roman-forum-palatine-hill-tour): Semi-private 3-hour Rome tour: Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Hill
- [Rome Food Tour - Eat like a Local](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/rome-food-tour): Award-winning Trastevere food tour featuring authentic Roman cuisine & wine
- [Colosseum Express Arena Tour](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/colosseum-express-arena-tour): 1.5-hour express tour: Colosseum arena floor & Roman Forum with skip-line
- [Painting With Wine: Tipsy Art Class](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/painting-with-wine-tipsy-art-class): Rome Tipsy Art Class: paint Italian masterpieces while wine tasting
